text_block_list.text: On our way back from an outing with Air Shakur, she said she was going to watch a freestyle race, so I accompanied her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out. Just so you know,
I'm not doing any more favors for you.
Ah, wait, let's go together—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Enough—leave me alone.

I managed to put her in a bad mood during our last outing.
I really hope I can be of some help today, though—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have time to deal with you.
If you're gonna stick around, keep it down."

Seeing her serious expression, I kept quiet so as not to disturb her.
Was her goal to gather data on the runners after all?
—Just then...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Gathering data in a place like this, too?
Must be tough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Haaah? What's it to you?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't get so defensive.
It's just rare to see someone from the Academy here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess you got lucky, huh?
Today's lineup had a decent amount of promise—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ain't interested.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I ain't interested—I mean, most runners here
are self-taught, so they're useless as data."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Collecting useless data just creates more garbage.
I ain't got time for that kind of inefficiency.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. In the end, are you the type whose vision
gets clouded without the stamp of authority?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?

I finally stepped in as the air grew tense.
Air Shakur was often misunderstood, but she was never
the kind of Umamusume to look down on others.
choice_data_list: I think Air Shakur has a different motive in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna know, you two better shut up for a bit.
—The race is starting.

text_block_list.name: Competitors
text_block_list.text:
RAAAAAGHHHHH!!!!!!
UWOOOOOOOOOOHHHHH!!!!!!
(Waaaaaahhhhh!)

"Perhaps because this race was so special,
the roar of the crowd carried a ferocious, almost primal heat. Just then—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, you really can't beat this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, this is that "other objective" I was talking about.

With those words, Air Shakur operated
her computer, and a sharp sound
came blaring out—!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "...What's that? Behind the music, was that what we heard earlier...?"

The unfinished, abruptly ending track incorporated
sounds from the racetrack that had just
been sampled moments ago.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"While composing, when I felt like something was missing,
I remembered this place."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A craving. And a raw, simple passion—
That's what I needed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, passion of such purity
ain't gonna be lying around in some well-mannered place, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, the sound was to my liking.
I'm sure there are folks looking forward to its completion
—sorry for interrupting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, acting so high and mighty right till the end.
Thanks to that, I ended up wasting extra time.
choice_data_list: Still, it turned out to be a great song!
Still, it turned out to be a great song!
Did you really not collect any running data?
Did you really not collect any running data at all?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, acting so high and mighty right till the end.
Thanks to that, I ended up wasting extra time.
choice_data_list: Still, it turned out to be a great song!
Still, it turned out to be a great song!
Did you really not collect any running data?
Did you really not collect any running data at all?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Nothin' special, right?
Just killin' time, is all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Our business is done. Let's head back, too.

"Perhaps she simply feels no need to elaborate.
It was a day that revealed yet another stoic side of her dedication to music."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I made sure to check out this guy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you think about efficiency,
ya really think we just came out here to play around?

Seeing how she outmaneuvered Sirius Symboli,
I was genuinely impressed by how sharp she was.
